annotations.title: Screen a name against sanctions lists

description: Screen a name before you transact with it: is this person or company on a sanctions list, and which one? Checks OFAC SDN, the UN consolidated list, the EU Financial Sanctions File and the UK Sanctions List, and returns listed, mismatch, not_found or unknown. The answer names the lists that were consulted with each one's retrieval date (and the UK list's own report date); a list that was not consulted is named as not consulted, and unknown is the answer when we cannot tell. A near name is never reported as the same party, and a listed verdict stands even when another list was not consulted. Not advice, not a legal determination. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

country.description: Optional country to break ties. A listed country that disagrees with the one you give is a mismatch, never a match.

kind.description: Optional: whether the name is a company or a person. A similar name across the person/entity line is a different party.

name.description: The person or company name to screen, as it is published on the list or in your document.

name: check_sanctions
